The logic follows here is :

Case (i) :

1) A is sitting second to the right of B

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/857575acadc56292100f2f1f94f233162258c22a8877b51d2e0c0c2e2e331264.png]

Then the position of 'D' is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce3ef8b5c9efcf75a6b3578ae2928af3ad0633e3f2b84f13f6d01c79eb23be3e.png] 

In this case, "D is fourth left of F".

This statement is not present in options so it will be eliminated.

Case (ii):

1) A is sitting second to the right of B

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a621bcbb74ba74fb2f55659a8793c41cb60c8616a5ec3a9b228da5d4dfb8336.png] 

2) If C is second right of A

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34c63074d46639f2090caa8c75f4bf763383b26bff749fe8d0fffb9243f612f2.png] 

3) While F is second to the right of E

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d9a89ce02e02e87f26335c9fd2f69f9488389815035faf81c6d693394d8b786.png] 

Then the position of 'D' is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0dcc5c0bb017e9dabd15b67c364699c52f0a9170a8c7d2c4d5e3ca6fb0a841ed.png] 

In this case, **"D is second right of F".**

Hence, sitting position of D is second right in respect of F.

Thus, the correct answer is **"Second right"**.

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by four conclusions numbered I, Il, Ill and IV. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some advocates are doctors.

Some doctors are players.

All players are engineers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some players are doctors.

Il. Some engineers are advocates.

Ill. All advocates are engineers.

IV. Some engineers are doctors.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Both conclusions I and IV follow
Both conclusions I and III follow
Both conclusions II and IV follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81762fb525c71a3245c0ecac9bda04236ff02d4f1cb428bfc28466267e6bd97a.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some players are doctors → True (As some doctors are players, so some players are doctors is True)

Il. Some engineers are advocates → False (No direct relation is given hence, False)

Ill. All advocates are engineers → False (No direct relation is given hence, False)

IV. Some engineers are doctors→ True (As all players are engineers and some doctors are players, So some engineers are doctors is True)

Thus, **Both conclusions I and IV follow**.

questions.question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following number series?

168, 168, 84, 28, ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :

168 ÷ 1 = 168

168 ÷ 2 = 84

84 ÷ 3 = 28

**28 ÷ 4 =** **7**

Thus, the correct answer is** "7"**.

**1) First all alphabets (letters) are arranged in alphabetical order (i.e. A to Z).**

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as the numbers of the following set.

46 : 82 : 154
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

46 : 82 : 154

4 + 6 = 10

8 + 2 = 10

1 + 5 + 4 = 10

Similarly,

**62 : 116 : 224**

**6 + 2 = 8**

**1 + 1 + 6 = 8**

**2 + 2 + 4 = 8**

Thus, the correct answer is **"62 : 116 : 224".**
